_comment: Engine src/ files over the 2,000-line limit (tests/src-file-size.test.ts, repository layout plan slice E0, 2026-11-27). Shrink-only: a file listed here may shrink, not grow, and comes off the list once it is at or under the limit. A count that goes down is recorded with UPDATE_SRC_FILE_SIZE=1 npx vitest run tests/src-file-size.test.ts, which also drops files under the limit. No file is ever added: split a new oversized file instead.
